changelog: Multi-seat props: benches, sofas and booths can have as many seats as you need, each with its own position, animation and name
A sit made on a prop now works on every copy of that model, including ones that spawn later (Only this one is still available)
Ghost preview of the seat layout while placing seats
Seats are handed out by the server, two players can no longer take the same seat; Choose a seat shows which ones are free
Third-eye shows on every copy of a configured prop, survives target restarts and works on qb-target
Sit packs switch on and off live without a restart
Lower CPU and network usage, stricter server checks on everything the creator saves
